standard_prerequisites.use: Justifies the equivalently-all clause and the Galois upgrade.

core_obligations: Since A is integrally closed in K and K = L^G with B integral over A, the invariants of B under G equal A (proof lines 33243-33244). The one-orbit-geometric lemma then gives that the residue field extension kappa(m)/kappa is normal and that the decomposition group D surjects onto its automorphism group, proving (1) and (2) (proof lines 33244-33245). The equivalence of the separability condition for one or all maximal ideals follows from the galois lemma (proof lines 33245-33246). With separability, normal plus surjective onto automorphisms says exactly that kappa(m)/kappa is Galois with D surjecting onto its Galois group, proving (3) and (4) (proof lines 33246-33248).
proof_roadmap: Identify A = B^G and apply the one-orbit-geometric lemma for (1) and (2) (proof lines 33243-33245).
Transfer separability across primes via the galois lemma and conclude (3) and (4) definitionally (proof lines 33245-33248).
